title: Algorithms tab: list agent and market clearing algorithms and edit their default parameters
approval_note: Requested by the user on 2026-10-07 (PLAN.md 2.12): a sidebar tab listing agent and market algorithms in two columns, click to edit parameters. Decisions: editing changes the global default and every run stores a snapshot of the parameters it used. Clearing algorithms get editable parameters like agent algorithms.
depends_on: PLAN 2.10 merged (registries of agent and clearing algorithms, Market.clearing_algorithm).

agent_algorithms.defaults: AlgorithmDefault (one row per algorithm key, params JSON) is the global default edited on the page. Effective parameters of an agent = config class defaults, overridden by AlgorithmDefault.params, overridden by Agent.algorithm_params (existing order OQ-9, unchanged).
agent_algorithms.form: Generated from the algorithm's config class (dataclass fields, type hints, docstring attribute descriptions, default_search_bounds as hints). Validation through config_class.from_dict, errors per field. Shows the class default next to each field and marks fields whose value differs from it. 'Reset to published defaults' deletes the AlgorithmDefault row (with an in-page confirmation, no confirm()).
agent_algorithms.info: Each card shows key, label, description, learning or baseline, on/off-policy, and how many library agents and scenarios use the algorithm.

clearing_algorithms.config: BaseClearingAlgorithm gains an optional ClassVar config_class (a frozen dataclass with from_dict/to_dict like AlgorithmConfig, default an empty config). The clearing algorithm receives its validated config on construction. MERIT_ORDER has an empty config.
clearing_algorithms.defaults: New model ClearingDefault(algorithm_key unique, params JSON) edited on the page, same form generator and reset as agents.
clearing_algorithms.per_scenario: Market.clearing_params JSON (default {}) holds per-scenario overrides, edited in the wizard market step under the clearing algorithm select (form generated from the config class, hidden when the class has no fields). Effective = class defaults < ClearingDefault < Market.clearing_params. Scenario YAML gets optional market.clearing_params.
clearing_algorithms.migration: One migration after 0017 for ClearingDefault, Market.clearing_params and the snapshot fields.

snapshot.fields: Agent.effective_params JSON null (filled only on run agents) and Market.effective_clearing_params JSON null (filled only on run markets), written once in SimulationContext.build from the resolved configs (to_dict).
snapshot.rule: A run never reads defaults again after build. Changing a default affects only runs started afterwards. Warm start and HPO keep their current override behaviour, and the snapshot records what was actually used.
snapshot.display: The analysis tab shows the snapshot per agent and for the clearing algorithm (collapsible), and the analysis CSV/ZIP export includes it as a JSON file.

page.url: algorithms/ (name algorithm_list), algorithms/agent/<key>/ and algorithms/clearing/<key>/ for GET/POST of the parameter form (JSON errors), reset endpoints. Sidebar entry 'Algorithms' after the library entries.
page.layout: Two columns on desktop (Agent algorithms | Market clearing algorithms), stacked on phones. Cards in the existing style (abmem.css contrast rules). Clicking a card opens the parameter editor (modal or detail page). An algorithm whose module failed to import is shown with its error.

tests: Form generation from config classes (types, defaults, descriptions), validation errors per field, save and reset for agent and clearing defaults.
Effective parameter resolution order for agents and clearing, wizard clearing_params save and YAML round trip.
Snapshot written at build, unchanged after a later default edit, shown in analysis and included in the export.
A test-only clearing algorithm with parameters is listed, editable and receives its config in a run.
Full suite green including the result fingerprint.
